title: Running Commentary on Torah 21 — Atika Tamir v'Satim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 21 — עתיקא טמיר וסתים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Frame**: **Perek Rivi'a'ah d'Sifra d'Tzni'usa** — Chapter 4 of Sifra d'Tzni'usa (Zohar Terumah 176b ff).

intermediate.en: **Perek Rivi'a'ah** (Sifra d'Tzni'usa)
intermediate.he: **פרקא רביעאה** (ספרא דצניעותא)

scholarly.he: פרקא רביעאה דספ"ד.

beginner.en: **Opening line of the Sifra d'Tzni'usa**: **"Atika tamir v'satim..."** — 'The Ancient One is concealed and hidden...' (decoded at end): Atika = **makifim** (encompassing lights concealed in this world, revealed l'asid); Z'eir Anpin = sechel a person can attain, containing its own **penimi u'makif**.

intermediate.en: **"Atika tamir v'satim..."** — decoded: Atika=**makifim**; Z"A=attainable sechel (penimi+makif).
intermediate.he: **"עתיקא טמיר וסתים..."** — פענוח: עתיקא=**מקיפים**; ז"א=שכל נתפס (פנימי+מקיף).

scholarly.he: עתיקא/ז"א = מקיפים/שכל.

beginner.en: **Aggadic hook**: **"B'ha'alos'cha es ha'neiros"** (Bamidbar 8:2) — Rashi: **"she'tehei shalheves olah mei'eileha"** — 'that the flame rise on its own.' Key to the Torah — the **shalheves** (flame) is the sechel rising on its own = the makif absorbed into penimi.

intermediate.en: **"B'ha'alos'cha es ha'neiros"** (Bam 8:2; Rashi: **"shalheves olah mei'eileha"**)=sechel rising.
intermediate.he: **"בהעלותך את הנרות"** (במ' ח, ב; רש"י: **"שלהבת עולה מאליה"**)=שכל עולה.

scholarly.he: במ' ח, ב; רש"י — שלהבת עולה מאליה.

intermediate.en: **"א"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"א"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף א.

beginner.en: **"**'Achor va'kedem tzartani'** (Tehillim 139:5). **Two kinds of sechel**: (1) **achor** = sechel attained by many **hakdamos** (premises, deductions); (2) **kedem = panim** = sechel that comes **with no hakdamah**, via **shefa Eloki** (divine inflow)."** **"The **hislahavus** of the heart for kedushah comes only from the panim-sechel — **'kalu she'ari v'libi'** (Tehillim 73:26) — not from achor which is mere accumulation."**

intermediate.en: **2 sechels**: (1) **achor**=by hakdamos; (2) **kedem/panim**=shefa Eloki, no hakdamah. **"Achor va'kedem tzartani"** (Teh 139:5). Hislahavus only from panim.
intermediate.he: **ב' שכלים**: (1) **אחור**=בהקדמות; (2) **קדם/פנים**=שפע אלוקי, ללא הקדמה. **"אחור וקדם צרתני"** (תה' קלט, ה). התלהבות רק מפנים.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. תה' קלט, ה.

intermediate.en: **"ב"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ב"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב.

beginner.en: **"Reaching **shefa Eloki** requires sanctifying **peh, chotem, einayim, oznayim** — they illuminate for him the shefa. **Peh** — guarding from sheker. **Chotem** = **yiras shamayim**: **'v'haricho b'yiras Hashem'** (Yeshayahu 11:3). **Einayim** — guarding from bad sight. **Oznayim** — guarding from bad hearing. These **7 neiros** (face's openings: 2 eyes + 2 ears + 2 nostrils + mouth) illuminate penei ha'menorah."**

intermediate.en: **Shefa Eloki via sanctifying 7 face-openings**: peh (no sheker), chotem (yiras shamayim, Yesh 11:3 "v'haricho"), einayim, oznayim. 7 openings=7 neiros illuminating pnei ha'menorah.
intermediate.he: **שפע אלוקי ע"י קידוש ז' פתחי פנים**: פה (ללא שקר), חוטם (יר"ש, יש' יא, ג "והריחו"), עיניים, אוזניים. ז' פתחים=ז' נרות מאירים פני המנורה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. ז' פתחי פנים; יש' יא, ג.

intermediate.en: **"ג"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ג"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג.

beginner.en: **"**Shefa Eloki = sukkah** — **'she'sachah b'ruach ha'kodesh'** (Megillah 14a; 13a — 'avi sucho she'na'aseh l'Yisrael k'sukkah'; Vayikra Rabbah 1:3 — 'avi sucho = avi ha'neviim she'sachu b'ruach ha'kodesh'). **Ruach ha'kodesh = shefa Eloki.**"**

intermediate.en: **Sukkah**=**"sachah b'ruach ha'kodesh"** (Meg 14a; 13a; VR 1:3 "avi sucho=avi ha'neviim"). **RuChK=shefa Eloki**.
intermediate.he: **סוכה**=**"סכה ברוח הקודש"** (מג' יד.; יג.; ויק"ר א, ג "אבי סוכו=אבי הנביאים"). **רוה"ק=שפע אלוקי**.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. סוכה=רוה"ק (מג' יד./יג.; ויק"ר א, ג).

beginner.en: **"ד. Sukkah=RuChK=shefa Eloki = **makifim** — the sechel is **too vast for the mo'ach to contain**, so it **encompasses the head** from outside. As we see many deep chochmos the mo'ach can't grasp — they remain makif to the head."**

intermediate.en: **ד. Sukkah/RuChK/shefa=makifim** — sechel too great for mo'ach → encompasses head (cf. deep chochmos ungraspable by mo'ach).
intermediate.he: **ד. סוכה/רוה"ק/שפע=מקיפים** — שכל גדול מדי למוח → מקיף את הראש (כמו חכמות עמוקות שאין מוח סובל).

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. מקיפים>פנימי.

beginner.en: **"This is ikkar **koach ha'bechirah**. While sechel isn't large enough to grasp **y'di'ah u'bechirah** together, bechirah stands firm — he can choose life or the opposite. But when the **makif enters penimi**, and human sechel grows to grasp **both yedi'ah and bechirah** — bechirah ends; he exits the gadder of anushi and ascends to gadder malach. Bechirah's essence is the non-grasp of this paradox."** **"Chazal (Berachos 17a): l'asid tzaddikim yoshvim v'atroseihem **b'rosheihem** — **'al rosheihem'** would be expected, but the atarah is **b'rosheihem** (inside) because l'asid bechirah ends — makifim enter penimi. Tzaddikim sit — no more war of bechirah."**

intermediate.en: **Ikkar koach habechirah** while sechel can't grasp **yedi'ah+bechirah** paradox. Makif→penimi → bechirah ends → exit anushi→malach. **Ber 17a**: l'asid tzaddikim "atroseihem **b'rosheihem**" (not 'al)=makifim in penimi.
intermediate.he: **עיקר כוח הבחירה** כל זמן ששכל לא תופס פרדוקס **ידיעה+בחירה**. מקיף→פנימי → בחירה מתבטלת → יציאה מגדר אנושי→מלאך. **בר' יז.**: לעתיד צדיקים "עטרותיהם **בראשיהם**" (לא 'על)=מקיפים בפנימי.

scholarly.he: בחירה=אי־תפיסת הפרדוקס; בר' יז. — עטרה בראש (לא על).

beginner.en: **"ה. This is bechina of **kiddushin = chupah** — shefa Eloki = **kodesh = chupah = makif**. Chazal (Bava Basra 75a): **'kol tzaddik v'tzaddik nich'veh mei'chupaso shel chaveiro'** — each tzaddik's makif is greater than the other's, and one's makif is another's penimi."** **"**7 yemei ha'mishteh** after chupah = **7 neiros** above → entering makif into penimi."** **"**7 yemei aveilus** — mourning for the departed neshamah, so it ascends to **or-ha'panim** over those 7 days."**

intermediate.en: **ה. Kiddushin/chupah=makif.** BB 75a "kol tzaddik nich'veh mei'chupaso shel chaveiro" — one's makif is another's penimi. **7 yemei mishteh**=makif→penimi. **7 yemei aveilus**=neshamah rising to or-panim.
intermediate.he: **ה. קידושין/חופה=מקיף.** ב"ב עה. "כל צדיק נכווה מחופתו של חבירו" — מקיף של זה פנימי של זה. **ז' ימי משתה**=מקיף→פנימי. **ז' ימי אבלות**=נשמה עולה לאור הפנים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. ב"ב עה.; ז' ימי משתה/אבלות.

beginner.en: **"ו. Reason for **rok of chalitzah** — **'v'yarkah b'panav'** (Devarim 25:9) — **'b'panav' dayka**: this brother leaves no zera — no future tikkun of or-ha'panim through offspring — and the brother refuses yibum. Therefore the spit goes **in his face** — he refused to revive his brother's name. In this rok the dead brother's face sometimes appears; the bushah is **ikar in the panim**."**

intermediate.en: **ו. Rok chalitzah**: **"v'yarkah b'panav"** (Dev 25:9; b'panav dayka): no zera=no tikkun or-panim; brother refuses yibum → spit in his face (dead brother's face appears in rok); bushah=ikar b'panim.
intermediate.he: **ו. רוק חליצה**: **"וירקה בפניו"** (דב' כה, ט; בפניו דייקא): ללא זרע=ללא תיקון אור הפנים; אחיו סרב ליבם → רוק בפניו (פני המת נראים ברוק); בושה=עיקר בפנים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. דב' כה, ט — וירקה בפניו; בושה בפנים.

beginner.en: **"**'V'aviha yarok yarak b'paneha, ha'lo sikalem shiv'as yamim'** (Bamidbar 12:14) — **shiv'as yamim dayka** = 7 ananim on which pnei ha'menorah are lit. Miriam pagmah kvod Moshe (shefa Eloki — **'ki karan ohr panav'** Shemos 34:29) — pagmah 7 neiros. Moshe was **anav, shafel, savlan** — didn't anger at insult — hence bushas panim via sh'iv'as yamim. Chazal (Yevamos Perek Rabban Gamliel): **yevamah niknesses b'ma'amar** — opposite of bushah: **'kulo omer kavod'** (Tehillim 29:9) — opposite of 'sikalem shivas yamim.'"**

intermediate.en: **"V'aviha yarok b'paneha sikalem shiv'as yamim"** (Bam 12:14) — 7=neiros. Miriam pagmah Moshe-shefa Eloki ("karan ohr panav," Shem 34:29). **Yevamah b'ma'amar** (Yev)=opposite — "kulo omer kavod" (Teh 29:9).
intermediate.he: **"ואביה ירק ירק בפניה תכלם שבעת ימים"** (במ' יב, יד) — ז'=נרות. מרים פגמה שפע אלוקי של משה ("קרן אור פניו", שמ' לד, כט). **יבמה במאמר** (יב')=הפך — "כולו אומר כבוד" (תה' כט, ט).

scholarly.he: במ' יב, יד; שמ' לד, כט; יב'; תה' כט, ט.

beginner.en: **"Aharon's prayer: **'al na t'hi ka'meis asher b'tzei'so mei'rechem imo va'yochal chatzi b'saro'** (Bamidbar 12:12). Via **segiru d'nehora ila'ah** one becomes bechina of **meis** — **'metzora chashuv k'meis'** (Nedarim 64b). **'B'tzei'so mei'rechem imo'** = yibum, for via yibum **'at'teta amma'** (wife becomes mother). **'Va'yochal chatzi b'saro'** = no zivug partner — husband+wife are **trei palga gufa** (two halves of one body); now wife=mother → **half-body devoured**."**

intermediate.en: **"Al na t'hi ka'meis... b'tzei'so mei'rechem... yochal chatzi b'saro"** (Bam 12:12): segiru d'nehora=meis (metzora=meis, Ned 64b); yibum="at'teta amma" (wife→mother); husband+wife=trei palga gufa → half-body devoured (no partner).
intermediate.he: **"אל נא תהי כמת... בצאתו מרחם... יאכל חצי בשרו"** (במ' יב, יב): סגירו דנהורא=מת (מצורע=מת, נד' סד:); יבום="אתתא אמא" (אשה→אם); בעל+אשה=תרי פלגא גופא → חצי גוף נאכל (ללא זוג).

scholarly.he: במ' יב, יב; נד' סד:; סגירו/יבום/חצי בשר.

intermediate.en: **"ז"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ז"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז.

beginner.en: **"Sometimes mochin/shefa Eloki is in **he'eilam** = **ibbur** (pregnancy). Then crying is fitting — in tefilah or Torah — when mochin withdraw. **He'eilam/ibbur** = **'tzur yeladcha teshi'** (Devarim 32:18); **'u'kho'ach ein la'leidah'** (Yeshayahu 37:3) — like a woman whose strength has waned from bearing; when she crouches to birth she raises **70 kolos** (matching the words of Tehillim 20 'ya'ancha') — and then births (Zohar Pinchas 249b). 70 kolos = David's 7 kolos on the waters × 10. Crying in tefilah/Torah during ibbur = **tzei'akas ha'yoledes**, HKBH answers."**

intermediate.en: **ז. Mochin in he'eilam=ibbur** → crying (tefilah/Torah). "Tzur yeladcha teshi" (Dev 32:18); "koach ein la'leidah" (Yesh 37:3). 70 kolos = Teh 20 "ya'ancha" = 7 Davidic kolos × 10 (Zohar Pin 249b) = tza'akas ha'yoledes.
intermediate.he: **ז. מוחין בהעלם=עיבור** → צעקה (תפילה/תורה). "צור ילדך תשי" (דב' לב, יח); "כוח אין ללידה" (יש' לז, ג). ע' קולות = תה' כ "יענך" = ז' קולות דוד × 10 (זוה"ק פינ' רמט:) = צעקת יולדת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. דב' לב, יח; יש' לז, ג; תה' כ; זוה"ק פינ' רמט:.

intermediate.en: **"ח"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ח"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ח.

beginner.en: **"Learning Torah without grasping any **chiddush** — mochin of that learning are in ibbur. Called **Yaakov** — **'ba'beten akav es achiv'** (Hoshea 12:4). One must cry the **kolos** (tears). **'Ha'kol kol Yaakov'** (Bereshis 27:22) — in Yaakov-mode, kolos are needed to draw out mochin in leidah."** **"One whose Torah has no chiddush should not expound to rabbim — though HKBH delights in it ('v'diglo alai ahavah' — read **v'lig'lugo**, Midrash), it isn't for the rabbim. Weep and await leidah."**

intermediate.en: **ח. Torah without chiddush=mochin in ibbur=Yaakov** ("akav es achiv," Hoshea 12:4). "Ha'kol kol Yaakov" (Ber 27:22) → kolos=leidah. Don't darshein to rabbim; HKBH "v'diglo=v'lig'lugo alai ahavah."
intermediate.he: **ח. תורה ללא חידוש=מוחין בעיבור=יעקב** ("עקב את אחיו", הו' יב, ד). "הקול קול יעקב" (בר' כז, כב) → קולות=לידה. לא לדרוש לרבים; הקב"ה "ודגלו=ולגלוגו עלי אהבה".

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. הו' יב, ד; בר' כז, כב; דגלו=לגלוגו.

beginner.en: **"ט. We are called **'am segulah'** (Devarim 7:6) — like a segulah (folk-remedy): though nature doesn't mandate it, it heals — **above nature, beyond human sechel**. So too HKBH chose us as His segulah people — though at kri'as yam suf middas ha'din protested **'hallalu ovdei akum, hallalu ovdei akum'** (BR 57; ShR 21) — yet HKBH took us as **am kadosh**. This is **above nature, above human sechel**, in the aspect of Atika."**

intermediate.en: **ט. "Am segulah"** (Dev 7:6)=segulah-remedy=above nature. Kri'as yam suf: middas din protests ("hallalu ovdei akum," BR 57; ShR 21); yet HKBH chose us — above human sechel=Atika.
intermediate.he: **ט. "עם סגולה"** (דב' ז, ו)=סגולה=מעל הטבע. קר"י: מידת הדין ("הללו עובדי ע"ז", ב"ר נז; שמ"ר כא); בכל זאת בחרנו — מעל שכל=עתיקא.

scholarly.he: סעיף ט. דב' ז, ו; ב"ר נז; שמ"ר כא.

beginner.en: **"Each person per his bechina has **penimi + makif**. Whatever Hashem grants to be brought makif→penimi (to understand/chadesh) — **righteousness demands he reveal the segulah to am segulah** and benefit others."**

intermediate.en: Each has penimi+makif; duty to **reveal each makif→penimi** chiddush to **am segulah**.
intermediate.he: לכל אחד פנימי+מקיף; חובה **לגלות כל מקיף→פנימי** לעם סגולה.

scholarly.he: גילוי החידוש לעם סגולה.

beginner.en: **"Peirush Perek Rivi'a'ah d'Sifra d'Tzni'usa**: **'Atika tamir v'satim, Z'eir Anpin isgalya v'lo isgalya.'** **Atika** = **makifim** hidden in olam hazeh, revealed only l'asid. **Z'eir Anpin** = human chochmos graspable; also contains **penimi + makif** per each one's bechina. Matters beyond human reach are from Atika; graspable ones are Z"A. Sometimes hidden (he'eilam/ibbur) = **'lo isgalya'**; then revealed = **'isgalya.'**"**

intermediate.en: **Peirush Perek 4 Sifra d'Tzni'usa**: **Atika**=makifim (hidden until l'asid); **Z"A**=attainable chochmos (penimi+makif, bechina-relative). **Isgalya v'lo isgalya**=revealed/hidden (ibbur).
intermediate.he: **פירוש פרקא ד ספ"ד**: **עתיקא**=מקיפים (נסתרים עד לעתיד); **ז"א**=חכמות נתפסות (פנימי+מקיף, לפי הבחינה). **איתגליא ולא איתגליא**=גלוי/נסתר (עיבור).

scholarly.he: פענוח ספ"ד פ"ד: עתיקא=מקיפים; ז"א=נתפס; איתגליא/לא.

beginner.en: **"יא. **'Nachamu nachamu ami'** (Yeshayahu 40:1). All tzaros/yisurim/galus are per **chisaron ha'da'as**. When da'as is complete, all chisronos are complete — **'im da'as kanisa, mah chasarta'** (Nedarim 41a); **'lachen galah ami mi'bli da'as'** (Yeshayahu 5:13; Sanhedrin 92b). Ikkar **chayim nitzchiyim l'asid = da'as**: all will know Hashem → **nichlalim b'achduso** → live as He lives. Ikkar yedi'ah l'asid: **'ki mal'ah ha'aretz dei'ah'** (Yeshayahu 11:9)."**

intermediate.en: **יא. "Nachamu nachamu"** (Yesh 40:1). Tzaros ∝ chisaron da'as. Shleimus da'as = shleimus all ("da'as kanisa mah chasarta," Ned 41a; Yesh 5:13 "galah ami mi'bli da'as," San 92b). L'asid chayim nitzchiyim = da'as ("mal'ah ha'aretz dei'ah," Yesh 11:9) → nichlal b'achduso → chai k'moso.
intermediate.he: **יא. "נחמו נחמו"** (יש' מ, א). צרות ∝ חסרון דעת. שלמות דעת = שלמות כולה ("דעת קנית מה חסרת", נד' מא.; יש' ה, יג "גלה עמי מבלי דעת", סנ' צב:). לעתיד חיים נצחיים = דעת ("מלאה הארץ דעה", יש' יא, ט) → נכלל באחדותו → חי כמוהו.

scholarly.he: סעיף יא. יש' מ, א; ה, יג; יא, ט; נד' מא.; סנ' צב:.

beginner.en: **"Even the umos will know the **yisron ha'da'as** — not as we will, but enough to see that the gedulah they held and the shiflus we bore in galus was **for our benefit**; though now inconceivable (chush can't be denied), then they'll understand. **'Az yimalei sechok pinu... az yomru va'goyim: higdil Hashem la'asos im eileh — higdil Hashem la'asos imanu'** (Tehillim 126:2-3) — the umos will admit: the gedulah done with us was Hashem's greatness."**

intermediate.en: **Umos will know yisron da'as** — see their galus-gedulah was for us. **"Az yimalei sechok pinu... az yomru va'goyim: higdil Hashem... im eileh — higdil Hashem imanu"** (Teh 126:2-3).
intermediate.he: **האומות ידעו יתרון הדעת** — יכירו שגדלות גלותן הייתה לנו. **"אז ימלא שחוק פינו... אז יאמרו בגויים: הגדיל ה'... עם אלה — הגדיל ה' עימנו"** (תה' קכו, ב-ג).

scholarly.he: תה' קכו, ב-ג.

beginner.en: **"And then he began saying this whole matter: **'chayim nitzchiyim'** etc. — meaning: one who merits true da'as of Hashem, no distinction between **chayim u'misah** — he is bound and included in Him in life and death; only now his dwelling is here, then there. (From here I heard from his holy mouth:)"**

intermediate.en: **True da'as of Hashem**=no chiluk chayim/misah; bound to Him; different dwellings. (R"N: from holy mouth.)
intermediate.he: **דעת אמיתית**=אין חילוק חיים/מיתה; דבוק בו; מקומות שונים. (ר"נ: מפי הקודש.)

scholarly.he: דעת אמת=חי ומת שוין.

beginner.en: **"**Chayim nitzchiyim** are only Hashem's, for He is **chai la'netzach**. One who is nichlal b'shorsho (i.e., in Him) is also chai la'netzach — once included in Echad, one with Hashem, he lives nitzchi like Him. Shleimus is only Hashem's; all else is chaser; one nichlal in Him has shleimus."** **"Ikkar kelalus is **via da'as** — as the Chakham said: **'ilu yeda'tiv, hayisiv'** — 'had I known Him, I would be Him.' The person's essence is sechel; where his sechel thinks, there he is; when he knows Hashem, he is **literally** there; the more he knows, the more nichlal b'shoresh."**

intermediate.en: **Chayim nitzchiyim** only Hashem's (chai la'netzach). Nichlal b'shoresh=chai k'moso. Shleimus only His. **Kelalus via da'as** ("ilu yeda'tiv hayisiv"): adam=sechel; where sechel=where adam; da'as Hashem → literally there.
intermediate.he: **חיים נצחיים** רק של ה' (חי לנצח). נכלל בשורש=חי כמוהו. שלמות רק שלו. **כלליות ע"י דעת** ("אילו ידעתיו הייתיו"): אדם=שכל; היכן שכל=היכן אדם; דעת ה' → ממש שם.

scholarly.he: חיים נצחיים/שלמות=רק ה'; כלליות בדעת (אילו ידעתיו הייתיו).

beginner.en: **Summary-difficulty frame**: **"Asked: there are makifim to **sechel** (not entering penimi ha'sechel) and makifim to **Torah** (not entering the Torah's penimi). Among makifim: some stand **before the eyes** (close), yet don't enter sechel; others are in **he'eilam** (ibbur) — not yet even at the makif level. What to do to bring makifim of Torah into Torah's penimi, and makifim of sechel into sechel's penimi — first they must emerge from he'eilam to makifim, then from makifim to penimi. Same for makifei ha'sechel — what's impossible to grasp from lack of penimi-sechel becomes graspable as makif enters penimi..."** (Torah ends mid-summary, pointing to further revelation.)

intermediate.en: **Closing Q**: makifim to sechel + to Torah; some at eye-level (makif but not penimi), some in he'eilam (ibbur). **Avodah**: he'eilam→makif→penimi, for both Torah-makifim and sechel-makifim.
intermediate.he: **שאלת סיום**: מקיפים לשכל ולתורה; חלק על העיניים (מקיף ולא פנימי), חלק בהעלם (עיבור). **עבודה**: העלם→מקיף→פנימי, לתורה ולשכל.

scholarly.he: סיכום: העלם→מקיף→פנימי; לתורה+שכל.
